messages:
Olivia Park: Heads-up — finalizing the week-of launch newsletter. Draft segments, send windows, and subject variants below. Need quick thumbs from product and growth by EOD. :rocket:
Sanjeev Rao: Sending now — can you share expected list sizes per segment? helps with throttling and ISP warmup.
Olivia Park: Primary: 85k (active devs, opened last 90d). Secondary: 40k (inactive but trialed). Webinar registrants: 6.2k (suppress from main send, separate invite).
Tess Morgan: Subject line A/B ideas? I can do quick copy sweep.
Olivia Park: A: "Redwood Inference — faster inference, lower cost"
Olivia Park: B: "Cut inference cost by up to 3x — launch & benchmarks inside"
Tess Morgan: I prefer B for higher CTR. Preheader: "New runtime improvements + live benchmark webinar"
Micah Lee: Quick personalization plan: first name fallback to "engineering team"; include company-level mention for leads with >=2 seats. Also add dynamic CTA for Dedicated vs Hosted.
Luis Ortega: Suppress list: webinar registrants + customers in active contract + hard bounces last 30d. Also please add global unsubscribe override (do not send).
Olivia Park: Schedule proposal: Staggered sends across timezones — US morning (10:00 PT), EMEA (10:00 GMT), APAC (10:00 SGT). Throttle: ramp 10% -> 30% -> full over 60 mins.
Olivia Park: Campaign config snippet for ops (copy to campaign tool):
```
campaign_name: "launch-news-2026-03"
segments:
  - primary_active
  - secondary_inactive
exclude:
  - webinar_registrants
  - customers_active
send_windows:
  - {tz: "US/Pacific", time: "10:00", ramp: [10,30,60]}
  - {tz: "Europe/London", time: "10:00", ramp: [10,30,60]}
  - {tz: "Asia/Singapore", time: "10:00", ramp: [10,30,60]}
AB_test:
  subject: ["A","B"]
preheader: "New runtime improvements + live benchmark webinar"
utm: "utm_campaign=launch_news_2026&utm_source=newsletter"
```
Sanjeev Rao: Looks good. For deliverability: set rate limit to 1200/min and monitor ISP backoff in first 30m. Ops alert if drop >15% vs expected.
Tess Morgan: I'll push final copy by 3pm and share subject line heatmap.
Micah Lee: I'll prep Dynamic CTA rules and fallback copy.
BrandBot: Campaign draft created: https://app.redwood/marketing/campaigns/launch-news-2026-03 (auto-generated id 7832) :mailbox_with_mail:
Olivia Park: Thanks team — if no major flags I'll hit send decision at 17:00 PT. Last call for copy/segment changes now. :eyes:
